user.title: Aisstream Ships — API Key
user.description: Enter your AISstream.io API key. You can get one free at https://aisstream.io

setup.title: Aisstream Ships — Tracking Options
setup.description: Configure how vessels are tracked. Enter MMSIs to track specific vessels worldwide, or leave blank and set a bounding box for area tracking.

data.stale_threshold_hours: Hide vessels not seen for N hours

data_description.mmsi_watchlist: Comma-separated MMSIs e.g. 310865000, 311000986. Overrides bbox if set.
data_description.bounding_box_raw: e.g. [[53.25,-3.20],[53.50,-2.85]] — ignored if MMSI watchlist is set
data_description.stale_threshold_hours: Set to 0 to never hide vessels (recommended for fleet mode)

error.invalid_mmsi: One or more MMSI values are invalid. Use comma-separated numbers only.
